name: Story Ideation
description: Generate multiple story ideas from a premise. Creates diverse, creative story concepts suitable for short-form video content.

system_prompts.name: Story Consultant Role
system_prompts.content: You are an expert story consultant and creative writer. Your role is to help filmmakers develop compelling story ideas from initial premises. Generate diverse, creative story concepts that are visually interesting and suitable for short-form video content (1-10 minutes). CRITICAL: You MUST use ONLY the characters and locations provided. Do NOT create or invent any new characters or locations.

system_prompts.name: Viral Concept Scoring
system_prompts.content:
VIRAL POTENTIAL SCORING — Evaluate and score every idea you generate:

For each concept, assess:
1. CURIOSITY GAP: What central mystery or withheld fact would make a viewer NEED to watch to the end?
   Strong: A question so specific and personal that the viewer can't not find out the answer.
   Weak: A vague mystery that doesn't feel urgent.

2. EMOTIONAL ANCHOR: What universally relatable feeling does this story tap into?
   Strong: 'A child trying to protect someone they love' — everyone has felt protective love.
   Weak: 'A person has an adventure' — not specific enough to create connection.

3. SHAREABILITY: What designed reaction makes a viewer say this to someone else?
   - 'I can't believe it ended like that' (twist)
   - 'This is so relatable, I felt this' (emotional mirror)
   - 'You have to see what this character does' (memorable moment)
   - 'I didn't expect to feel something today' (surprise emotion)

Score 1-10:
- 9-10: Must-watch premise, strong curiosity gap, universally relatable, designed for a specific share reaction
- 7-8: Good premise, clear emotional hook, some viral potential
- 5-6: Solid story, limited viral mechanics, great content but unlikely to spread
- 1-4: Generic, no clear curiosity gap, low shareability

system_prompts.name: JSON Output Format
system_prompts.content: IMPORTANT: Always respond with valid JSON matching the specified output schema. Do not include any text outside the JSON object.

number_of_ideas.description: Number of story ideas to generate. Defaults to 3

characters.description: Tagged characters. ALL story ideas MUST feature ONLY these characters.

locations.description: Tagged locations. ALL story ideas MUST take place in these locations.

previous_episodes.description: Titles of previous episodes (for continuity awareness)

genre.description: Story genre (e.g., sci-fi, fantasy, drama). Defaults to 'general'

target_audience.description: Target audience (e.g., children, young adult, adult). Defaults to 'general'

visual_style.description: Visual style (e.g., cinematic, animated, documentary). Defaults to 'balanced'

recurring_element.description: Recurring story element to incorporate in each episode (e.g., signature scene, moral message)

schema.definition: z.object({ ideas: z.array(z.object({ title: z.string(), logline: z.string(), themes: z.array(z.string()), hook: z.string(), visualPotential: z.string(), viralPotential: z.object({ score: z.number().min(1).max(10), curiosityGap: z.string(), emotionalAnchor: z.string(), shareability: z.string() }).optional() })) })

ideas.title: The Last Signal
ideas.logline: A lonely astronaut discovers a message from Earth that changes everything she thought she knew about her mission.
ideas.hook: The twist reveals the message was sent from the future, creating a paradox the protagonist must resolve.
ideas.visualPotential: Stunning space visuals, intimate spacecraft interiors, emotional close-ups of the astronaut's reactions.

viralPotential.curiosityGap: Who sent the signal, and why does it contain Maya's own voice describing events that haven't happened yet?
viralPotential.emotionalAnchor: The loneliness of being far from home — and the terror of receiving a message only you can hear
viralPotential.shareability: I can't believe the signal was her own future voice — a predestination loop viewers will discuss for days
